segments.text: Your temperature is up a little, and the knee pain is bad.
Take paramet, five hundred milligrams, three times a day after food.
Keep taking your meriforming, five hundred milligrams, twice daily.
If the fever lasts more than three days, call the clinic.
Come back and see me in one week.
